posts.name: chrismith85
posts.cooked:
Got her! My setup was Ra, Scholar, Argent Adept, Omniton-X, and Unity versus Ambuscade in the Block. I had a bunch of bots out, including all five F5 bots (though I don't think they all used their powers; Cryo Bot was never hit), ended with Unity at 7 HP, and a Raptor Bot dealt the finishing blow. Differences from my previous failed runs:

  • In two previous attempts I used the same team, but with Young Legacy in place of Ra. Maybe Young Legacy (or just Legacy in general) aren't allowed on the team? Would make some sense, since Golem Unity is from after Legacy left the team. Has anyone unlocked her when playing with Legacy?
  • I fought Ambuscade instead of Baron Blade. I doubt this made any difference, since other people have unlocked her with Blade, but it doesn't look like the Baron is required for the unlock.
  • I played "Powered Shockwave" near the end of the game, when 9 or 10 bots were out. Doesn't sound like this is a strict requirement, but maybe it help me hit a damage threshold that's required for the unlock. I also wonder if Unity herself has to deal a certain amount of damage, rather than her bots? I feel like I did less damage with her overall than in previous failed attempts, but since I played Shockwave this time Unity definitely dealt more damage personally than before.

posts.name: everlastingtilt
posts.cooked:
Got the unlock.  Used the whole F6 (minus Tempest), but that doesn't seem to matter.  Fought Blade in the Block, but it doesn't sound like either of those things matter either.

Did not use Powered Shockwave at all, so I think that's ruled out.

I did get the entire F5 Bot team in play, but as someone else mentioned too, Cryo didn't get hit so its power didn't get triggered.

In addition to the F5 Bots, I had 2 Platform Bots and a Raptor Bot.

Unity was at 7 hp at the end.

The only damage Unity did was from Bots.  Bunker got the final blow with the Omni Cannon.

If previous games matter, I had done the scenario where Blade kills Young Legacy on the Mars Base, and I'd both won and lost to Iron Legacy with an all F6 team before this.

 

Strange note on having Blade kill Young Legacy though.  I recently got a new tablet and didn't feel like fiddling with the legit unlocks all over again until the acheivements came out.  I just pushed the lazy button and got all my alts back.  So when Blade landed the finishing blow on Young Legacy, it also officially unlocked Young Legacy.  I guess the game doesn't distinguish between alts for the same character.  That's probably worth mentioning to Handelabra...

posts.name: mrfox1980
posts.cooked:
I got the unlock last night....

 

Team: Haka, SST, Omni-x, Unity
Villain: Ambuscade (He's just the easiest to test and unlock with in my eyes)
Environment: The Block (Just because it was fun)

SST and Omni-X were used to help Unity get out bots and equipment faster. Haka was used to deal with Ambuscade.

At the end....

Unity was at 7HP. Freedom 5 bots, 2 raptor bots, and a platform bot were out.  4 of the Freedom bots did their thing... Cryo was the only one that didn't fire off. raptor bots did 10 damage a piece and the platform bot finished off the job, getting the unlock.

Theory:  Based on the ARG that was used for Oblivaeon... I want to say that Omnitron-x has to be in party. It seems that Unity and Omnitron-X end up having quite the friendship. Also Golem Unity just kind of lends it self to a merge with Omnitron (SPECULATION on my end). Also, looking at the teams of people that unlocked it... most of them have Onmi-X in their line up.

 

So I am thinking...

Lose to Iron Legacy
Team has to have Onmitron-X in it
Play the 5 Freedom Bots and most of them have to use their power? (Cryo didn't though in my game)
Unity <10 Health
Win the battle.

Finally got the unlock. I had already lost to Iron Legacy (which I wouldn't be surprised if it is a condition for all of the Freedom 6).

I didn't get it after playing all of the Freedom 5 bots.

Neither when playing bots using all three methods.

Nor when I had one of each bot in play at the end of the game.

I did get the unlock when I did all three and when Unity's HP was less than the number of bots in play. weaden's theory I think fits as part of the condition.

My idea is that Unity must have been beaten by Iron Legacy. Then play all Freedom 5 bots in a game, and have Unity's HP lower than the number of bots in play at the end of a game.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
waedens has the final piece of this puzzle. Thanks to the investigative work here and on the Steam forums, the unlock conditions for Freedom Six Unity have been determined by the community. Well done everyone!
 
Lose a game to Iron Legacy with regular Unity on the team. Then, defeat any villain with regular Unity and without a Legacy on the team. Unity must end the game with more mechanical golems in play than her HP.
